title: Bind speech and clicks to shared selectable objects
problemCues: Person and assistant share charts, documents, or records across voice, text, and direct manipulation
preconditions: Application can identify artifacts and selections; writes go through typed commands
decision: Give task, artifact, selection, version, turn, and action stable identifiers. UI selection becomes bounded model context. User edits remain authoritative; cancel stale actions after interrupt.
tradeoffs: Requires state plumbing beyond a chat sidebar or avatar tile
exceptions: Single-turn spoken summaries with no shared working material — plain UI or transcript may win
validatedBy: Scripted interrupt and wrong-referent tests; drafts survive modality switches
